nodes.label: Observe
nodes.title: Observe
nodes.info: A mentor watches a student work through a challenge card or kit during a session.

nodes.label: Record
nodes.title: Record
nodes.info: The mentor marks the completed skill or badge in the tracking sheet before the session ends -- not on the drive home, when the detail is already gone.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.title: Review
nodes.info: Before the next session, a mentor -- often a different one -- reviews the student's row to see what is already mastered.

nodes.label: Adjust
nodes.title: Adjust
nodes.info: The mentor picks the next appropriate challenge card based on what the record shows, then the cycle repeats at Observe.
